propositions: Empty file_impact is ambiguous between undeclared and genuinely no-file-impact, causing conservative whole-HEAD invalidation and container poisoning even when no files are actually affected

Introducing tri-state file_impact_scope (undeclared/paths/none) with mandatory no_file_impact_reason for none allows explicit no-file-impact declarations to skip whole-HEAD fallback and avoid poisoning parent containers
A ticket explicitly declaring no file impact should maintain valid attestation across unrelated commits, while undeclared tickets still invalidate on any commit
Container inheritance should treat explicitly declared no-file-impact children as neutral (not poisoning), inheriting only path-declaring children's union
A new plan-review criterion must validate the truthfulness of no-file-impact assertions using LLM judgment, firing only when the assertion is present
State transitions between the three file_impact_scope values must change the material fingerprint to prevent retroactive attestation widening
